svg.title: M10: Atomic reservation and safe settlement
svg.desc: Two concurrent calls each request 1500 tokens with 8000 finally settled and a10000 cap. Only one fits after atomic reservation. A provisional1000-token usage report retains the bound; only full final settlement releases it.

g.text: Two callers cannot spend the same capacity.
Cap 10,000 • finally settled F = 8,000 • held bounds H = 0

g.title: IT request A with a verified1500-token bound
g.text: Exact request • verified aggregate bound B = 1,500

g.title: Concurrent network request B with a verified1500-token bound
g.text: Exact request • verified aggregate bound B = 1,500

g.title: Both callers use the same atomic run state
Atomically check and reserve against the shared run state
g.text: One shared transaction: F + H + B ≤ cap
Check run + request + policy; commit reservation + journal before ALLOW.

g.title: One reservation wins; the other sees the changed state
B cannot reserve the same remaining capacity
g.text: No reservation and no execution for this denied request.

g.title: A must claim dispatch once; reservation is not a reusable permission
g.text: A next claims dispatch once, then sends the exact request.
A committed dispatch claim does not prove provider execution. Ambiguous outcomes keep the bound.

g.title: Provisional actual usage does not release capacity
Only complete finality permits replacing the bound with final usage
g.text: Entire admitted execution set must be resolved.

g.title: Without verified finality, apparent savings are not recycled
g.text: No verified finality? Keep the full bound for the run. Actual accounting remains separate.
